summary: @or-sdk/source-api preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-style script (`_0x`-renamed identifiers, per-function string-property maps) that, when Bun is not present, downloads the Bun runtime zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary to 0755, and then uses it via `execFileSync` to run the package-bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `@bun-cjs` bundle heavily obfuscated with a shuffled string-array plus a `WV8StW` rotation decoder and hex-encoded constants, making the executed code opaque to inspection. The package advertises itself as a small HTTP client SDK; fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute an obfuscated bundle is unrelated to that stated purpose and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern (using Bun to run code that Node-based scanners will not analyze). The lifecycle hook fires automatically on `npm install`, so arbitrary code from the bundled obfuscated payload runs on the installer's machine without user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
